name: RestoFlow ERP MVP
description: Enterprise restaurant ERP system featuring POS with modifiers & split check, real-time Kitchen Display System (KDS), Floor & Table Management, Recipe BOM Inventory, full Procurement & Purchasing lifecycle (POs, Delivery Notes/GRN, 3-Way Match Invoices, Debit Notes), Accounting GL sync (QuickBooks/Sage), HR & Payroll sync (Gusto/ADP), Delivery Dispatch APIs, and Gemini AI operations copilot.
